basic_details.job_title: MNLU Mumbai Administrative Assistant Recruitment 2026 – Walkin
basic_details.short_information: Maharashtra National Law University Mumbai will hold a walk-in interview on 25 November 2026 at 12.00 noon onwards for one Administrative Assistant post (01 General). The post is on annual contract-consolidated pay of Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 35000/-. The notice is dated 18 November 2026 and signed by the Registrar; more information is on the university website, www.mnlumumbai.edu.in.

age_limit.details: The age limit is 18 Yrs to 32 Yrs. The notice states that qualifications, relevant experience and age are considered as on the last date of receipt of application. It does not list any age relaxation.

content_sections.heading: MNLU Mumbai Administrative Assistant Walk-in Interview Date, Time and Venue
content_sections.text: The official notification does not specify the application fee or the last date to apply. It also does not print a separate interview venue; the university's own address is given below.

rows.details: Eligible candidates with a Bachelor's Degree in any discipline (Arts, Science, or Commerce), aged 18 to 32 years

content_sections.heading: About MNLU Mumbai
content_sections.text: Maharashtra National Law University Mumbai was established on 27 June 2014 by the Government of Maharashtra under Act VI of 2014. Its address in the notice is 2nd and 6th Floor, MTNL-CETTM Building, Technology Street, Hiranandani Gardens, Powai, Mumbai, Maharashtra - 400 076.

content_sections.heading: Posts and Eligibility
content_sections.text: The notice invites candidates for one post, Administrative Assistant, with one vacancy in the General category. The post is offered on Annual Contract-Consolidated pay. A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline (Arts, Science, or Commerce) from a recognized University. Working knowledge of computers. Proficiency in the English Language, including communication skills. Master's degree (MBA, M. Com, or equivalent) in a relevant discipline. English Typing 30 WPM. Marathi Typing 30 WPM. Minimum 1-3 years of experience. The age limit is 18 Yrs to 32 Yrs. The notice states that qualifications, relevant experience and age are considered as on the last date of receipt of application. It does not list any age relaxation. For the full eligibility of the post, candidates should refer to the official notification.

content_sections.heading: What to Bring
content_sections.text: Candidates shall bring the following original documents at the time of the interview, along with two sets of xerox copies of all the documents: Documents related to educational qualifications, such as Degree/Diploma certificates, Statement of Marks, other certificates of the relevant examinations (both side photocopies of the Statement of Marks) and any other certificates relating to the educational qualifications. Certificate/s of experience issued by the competent Authority. Birth / SSC certificate or other Government document as a proof of date of birth. In case of change in name of the candidate, a copy of Government Gazette or any other appropriate certificate.

content_sections.heading: Important Instructions
content_sections.text: Candidates furnishing incorrect or false information shall stand disqualified at any stage, even after appointment. Candidates should check the eligibility criteria carefully while appearing for the interview. Candidates who are not eligible will be disqualified at any stage of the recruitment process, even after selection. The appointment is on Annual Contract-Consolidated pay, as stated in the notice.

faq.question: Q1. When is the MNLU Mumbai Administrative Assistant walk-in interview?
faq.answer: The walk-in interview is on 25/11/2026 at 12.00 noon onwards.

faq.question: Q2. How many Administrative Assistant posts are vacant?
faq.answer: There is one post, in the General category (01 General).

faq.question: Q3. What is the qualification for the Administrative Assistant post?
faq.answer: A Bachelor's Degree in any discipline (Arts, Science, or Commerce) from a recognized University, working knowledge of computers and proficiency in the English Language, including communication skills.

faq.question: Q4. What is the age limit?
faq.answer: The age limit is 18 Yrs to 32 Yrs, considered as on the last date of receipt of application.

faq.question: Q5. What is the salary for the post?
faq.answer: The pay is Rs. 25,000/- to Rs. 35000/- on Annual Contract-Consolidated pay.

faq.question: Q6. Which documents must candidates bring?
faq.answer: Originals with two sets of xerox copies of educational certificates and mark statements (both sides), experience certificate/s, a birth / SSC certificate or other Government proof of date of birth, and a Gazette or other certificate in case of a change of name.

faq.question: Q7. Is the Administrative Assistant job permanent?
faq.answer: The notice offers the post on Annual Contract-Consolidated pay, so it is a contract engagement.

faq.question: Q8. What is desirable for the post besides the essential qualification?
faq.answer: A Master's degree (MBA, M. Com, or equivalent) in a relevant discipline, English Typing 30 WPM, Marathi Typing 30 WPM and minimum 1-3 years of experience.

faq.question: Q9. What happens if a candidate gives false information?
faq.answer: Such a candidate stands disqualified at any stage, even after appointment.
